run_sam_segmentation: run the segment anything model on an image with point prompts on Intel Gaudi HPU
run_sam_benchmark: run SAM inference benchmarking with configurable warmup and iteration counts on HPU
run_sam_hpu_graphs: run SAM segmentation with HPU graphs enabled for improved latency on Gaudi
run_sam_bf16: run SAM segmentation using bfloat16 precision autocasting on Intel Gaudi HPU
run_sam_print_iou: run SAM segmentation and print the IoU scores for the segmented output
